dinner.name: Hungarian Goulash (Paprika Beef Stew)
dinner.description: Paprika beef stew - Hungary's national dish with rich flavors
ingredients: 1.2kg beef chuck or brisket, cut into 3cm cubes
instructions: Heat oil in large heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat
Working in batches, brown beef cubes on all sides (8-10 minutes per batch); set aside
Reduce heat to medium; add diced onion
Sauté onion until soft and translucent (7-8 minutes)
Add generous 60ml (1/4 cup) Hungarian paprika; stir constantly for 1-2 minutes until fragrant
This step is critical—paprika must not burn or turn bitter
Add tomatoes, stock, caraway seeds, bay leaves, marjoram
Bring to gentle boil; reduce heat to low, cover
Add carrots and potatoes; continue simmering 45-60 minutes more until beef is fork-tender
Taste and adjust salt and pepper
If desired, dissolve 1 tablespoon flour in 2 tablespoons cold water; stir in to thicken (optional)
Serve with dark sourdough rye bread or dumplings
dinner.notes: Hungarian paprika is crucial—sun-dried rather than smoked—producing the characteristic rich, red peppery flavor
dinner.fun_fact: Authentic Hungarian goulash uses extraordinary amounts of paprika; this is the national dish of Hungary dating back to 9th century shepherds
